title: FE↔QA-001: UI Test Builds + End-to-End Test Scenarios
description: Frontend provides testable UI builds and component/flow documentation to support test design; QA provides defect reports and end-to-end test scenarios covering real-time and edge-case flows. Grounded in FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.5 and QA_TEST_AUTOMATION_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7.

build_available.description: A deployable/testable UI build is available.

component_flow_docs.description: Component and flow documentation supporting test design.

test_hooks_present.description: Stable selectors / test IDs present for automation.

x-macp.tier_rationale: UI test-build handoff and e2e scenario design are agent-autonomous; defect outcomes feed the QA go/no-go at release.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER + CONTINUOUS (continuous integration with each pull request; formal QA cycle before production release)
confirm_conditions: ui_test_build carries a build_id and build_available = true with component/flow docs
qa_scenarios provide ≥1 e2e scenario covering real-time and edge-case flows
automation-targeted builds expose stable test hooks
defects carry a severity and reproducibility flag
reject_conditions: a production QA cycle requested without a testable build
real-time / edge-case flows omitted from the e2e scenario set
a CRITICAL defect closed without a regression scenario
counter_conditions: build lacks stable selectors for automation — request test hooks before authoring automated scenarios
scenario depends on backend data not yet available — request a fixture or mock
